company_stage: large public electric vehicle, energy, manufacturing, and AI company

culture_principles.name: Public mission and customer-impact alignment
culture_principles.description: Tesla fit should connect work to the company outcomes and users described in cited public sources.

culture_principles.name: Evidence-backed execution
culture_principles.description: Strong answers should show practical judgment, clear tradeoffs, ownership, and outcomes rather than generic enthusiasm.

culture_principles.name: First-principles engineering
culture_principles.description: Public material emphasises designing from physical and cost fundamentals rather than from industry convention, so inherited assumptions are expected to be challenged.

culture_principles.name: Vertical integration and ownership
culture_principles.description: The company publicly owns much of its stack from cells to software to service, which places end-to-end accountability on small teams.

culture_principles.name: Speed with real-world validation
culture_principles.description: Public positioning pairs fast iteration with safety and field data, so velocity claims need a validation mechanism to be credible.

hiring_signals.signal: Connects decisions to the users, customers, products, or markets named in public company sources.
Uses concrete examples to show ownership, learning, and measurable improvement.
Explains a design from physical or economic first principles rather than analogy to competitors.
Shows ownership of a problem that crossed hardware, software, and field operations boundaries.
States how a fast change was validated against safety or reliability requirements before shipping.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Generic admiration for the company without a concrete role, customer, product, or business mechanism.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public lens usage should stay grounded in cited source signals and role-relevant evidence.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Admiring mission or product ambition without an engineering mechanism or measurable tradeoff.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public signals are product and manufacturing oriented; mission enthusiasm provides nothing to evaluate.

anti_signals.anti_signal: Assuming one team culture across automotive, energy, and manufacturing operations.
anti_signals.risk_reason: Public sources describe materially different businesses with different operating constraints.

interview_patterns.pattern: Use cited public source signals to test role-relevant judgment, ownership, communication, and impact.

Hiring signals in this lens are derived interview-preparation suggestions: they translate public company positioning into questions a candidate can prepare for, and are not evidence that the company evaluates candidates on them.

honest_limits: This is a lightweight public-source lens and does not represent an official Tesla hiring standard.
It contains source metadata and non-verbatim public-safe signals only.
Role, team, seniority, location, and hiring manager can materially change interview emphasis.
This lens requires deeper multi-source validation before being promoted to FULLY_DISTILLED.
